subject: Tenant activation gating choreography — SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service-account sequencing
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claudia Ruiz <claudia@stratahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant activation gating choreography — SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service-account sequencing

Hi Claudia,

Thanks again for yesterday's kickoff. Per our conversation I sketched a minimal choreography for tenant activation that balances your security review windows and our staging cutover. High-level asks from StrataHealth: SAML SSO via IdP-initiated and SP-initiated, SCIM for role sync, IP allowlist for the staging cluster, and a dedicated service account for batch API calls.

Proposed sequencing (2-week window):
- Day 0: Exchange SAML metadata and SCIM base URL (you -> us)
- Day 1–2: Redwood verifies SAML metadata in staging; we provide test SP metadata
- Day 3: StrataHealth configures IP allowlist for staging egress (we provide IP CIDRs)
- Day 4: SCIM provisioning test with minimal group mapping (read-only)
- Day 6: Service account creation and key handoff (Rotating API key via KMS)
- Day 10: End-to-end smoke tests (login, provisioning, tokened API access)
- Day 12: Go/no-go review and production cutover window planning

Attachments: multi-tenant-gating-checklist.xlsx (checklist + owner columns), saml-metadata-urls.txt (sample endpoints).

Action items for StrataHealth: please confirm cadence and which team (IAM or infra) will own SAML metadata upload.

I'll loop in Marissa for rollout coordination and Rishi for the SCIM mapping specifics — Rishi, if you can add the minimal attribute map and service-account policy we should be good to share with Claudia.

Thanks,
Ben

-- 
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks — this looks good. IAM will own the SAML metadata upload; Infra will handle the IP allowlist. Two quick items:

2) For the service account, we need to see the least-priv privilege policy before creating the key.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant activation gating choreography — SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service-account sequencing

Claudia, Ben — thanks. Drafting the SCIM attribute map and the service-account IAM policy; see below for the minimal policy we recommend for the batch ingestion flow (tokens are rotated via customer-managed KMS):

- Permissions: api.read, api.write (scoped to /tenant/{tenant_id}/ingest), service_accounts.read
- Explicit deny: admin.* (no user creation via API)
- Key lifetime: 24h short-lived keys + 30-day rotating master creds

I'll attach a quick JSON snippet and the attribute mapping doc to the drive link. Regarding CIDRs: staging egress IPs are 34.82.120.0/24 and 34.82.121.0/24 (please confirm those can be whitelisted). We will avoid any changes on May 27 blackout.

Ben — Marissa and I recommend scheduling the smoke tests for May 30–31 to give your teams a buffer.

-Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
